tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bstan pa'i bka' srung a phyi chen mo'i mchod phreng bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru pad+ma de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ 'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dharma tā ra'i mchod phreng las byang gi rim pa spel ba la/ thog mar dur khrod la sogs pa nyer bzhi'i gnas sam/ grub thob bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sam yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dben par/ tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus tshes mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gza' skar dus sbyor bzang po la gtsang sbra legs par byas la/ rtsa ba gsum gyi rten dang*/ khyad par a phyi dang*/ tshe ring ma'i thang sku dang sku 'bag la sogs pa dang*/ dar sna stag gzig dkor nor spyan gzigs kyang ci 'byor pas brgyan cing*/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu'am/ yang na lnga tshom/ 'bru dkar gyi phye ma rtsi bcud kyis sbrus te gtor ma zlum po lnga/ 'ja' 'od bkra ba'i rgyan dang*/ rtsa ba gsum gyi gtor ma dang*/ sman gtor dang*/ bskul gyi dmar gtor gnyis dang*/ chad mdo/ brtan skyong*/ phyogs skyong gtor ma/ sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs dang*/ spro na/ bskang gtor bang rim gzhi'i steng*/ dbus mar a phyi gtso 'khor lnga'i zlum gtor dang*/ mtshams bzhir thugs sprul gsum dang spu gri ma bzhi'i gtor ma zur gsum bzhi/ de phyir tshe ring mched lnga'i zlum gtor/ mdun du khro mo'i gtor ma zur gsum liṅgas mtshan pa/ gnyis par brtan ma bcu gnyis la bshos bu zur gsum bcu gnyis/ de mthar dbang phyug nyer brgyad la rkang zor gyi rnam pa rang mdog gis bskor ba'i log bzhir tshogs kyi rnam pa bzhi dang*/ mthar mtheb kyus bskor/ gsum pa mdun nas g.yon skor du/ mda' dar me long brgyan pa/ thod ḍār/ nor bu 'bar ba/ thod khrag /sman thod/ rdo rje/ kha ṭām̐ ga /na bza'/ rus thod dang rgyan phreng*/ rkang gling*/ sba lcag /rin po che/ gser ḍār/ lcags kyu/ gri gug /mgo phreng*/ ne'u le/ thod pa nor bus gang ba/ ber/ dur khrod chas brgyad/ ral gri/ snying*/ nad rkyal/ bzhi pa rta sngo ser dmar nag sga chas ldan/

'brong*/ mkha' lding*/ bong bu/ spre'u/ spyang ki/ seng ge /stag 'brug /gla ba/ gser sha yu mo/ rkyang*/ khrung khrung*/ gzhan yang dkor nor rigs gang 'byor bkod/ phyogs bzhir khrung khrung rgyal mtshan/ mda' dar me long gis brgyan pa rnams btsugs/ mthar mchod pa sna tshogs dang mchod gtor rnams bshams/ nang mchod rtsa brgyad sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang*/ 'bru sman rin po ches sbrus pa'i gtor ma dang rak+ta sogs kyang bshams/ tshogs gtor dang dkar mo'i lag g.yas/ 'bru yi chang gi nying khu/ gzhan yang 'bru sna/ sman sna/ dar tshon/ zas sna shing thog gser skyems la sogs pa bshams nas rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas thog mar sngon 'gro skyabs sems kyi rim pa ni/ na mo/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum rab 'byams la// rtse gcig sgo gsum dad pa'i blos// dang ba'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun phyir mi ldog pa yi// byang chub go 'phang thob par shog / lan gsum/ de nas gnas bdag dang lan chags la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong yul lha sde brgyad rnams// mchod gtor bzang po 'di longs la// dkar phyogs kun gyis mthun rkyen spel// nag po'i phyogs gyur 'byung po'i rigs// bse rag brel 'phongs the'u rang sogs// so sor mos pa'i bza' dang btung*// lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la// mtha' med gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi nyan 'tshe byed na// nga nyid rdo rje srin po'i sku// dbang chen khros pa'i rngams zer gyis// bgegs tshogs thal bar brlag ta re// oṃ pad+man ta krit+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod yungs kar brab la gu gul 'dug /srung 'khor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi// ye shes me dpung rdo rje dang*// lcags sdig phur bu'i tshogs spros pas// sra brtan gzhom bral srung 'khor gyur// badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/

de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyang spel ba dang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ pad+man ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong par gyur pa'i ngang nyid las// bhūm̐ las rin chen pad+ma'i snod// yangs shing rgya che rnams kyi nang*// mchod pa'i rdzas gyur yid du 'ong// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri// ro bcud reg bya 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// sman dang rak+ta ba ling ta// bskang rten sgrub rdzas phun sum tshogs// 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi dngos// phyogs kun rgyas par 'gengs pa yi// nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin longs spyod tshogs// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pad+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo kai/ gan+dhe/ ne wi de/ shab+da/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+ṣe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ā hūm̐ swā hā/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ma hā ba ling ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de nas rang nyid lha bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā ṇa badz+ra swā bhā wa ad+ma ko3ṃ/ snang srid dngos kun chos thams cad// stong pa nyid gyur de'i ngang las// pad dkar zla nyi'i gdan steng du// hrīḥlas 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod// sems can kun gyi sgrib pa sbyangs// tshur 'dus rang nyid skad cig gis// o rgyan slob dpon rig pa 'dzin// pad+ma thod phreng sku mdog dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje// g.yon pas thod pa bcud bkang dang*// kha ṭām̐ dkur brten za 'og gi /chos gos rnam gsum phod ka dang*// pad zhwa rin chen rgyan spras gsol// snyan cha mgul rgyan phyag zhabs gdub// dar dpyangs cod pan lhab lhub g.yo// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// 'od 'phros chos dbyings dag zhing nas// bla ma sku gsum 'dus pa'i dpal// mtsho skyes dri med rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal ba sras dang btsun mor bcas// lnga ldan 'ja' 'od thig le dang*// thig phran me tog char chen dbus// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging gi tshogs// sprin chen rlung gis bskyod bzhin du// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med par// chu la chu bzhag lta bur gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// lha dang lha mo'i tshogs spros nas// gsang gsum dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// mchod pa'i bye brag du ma yis// mchod cing snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod// thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga'i lter// hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor// 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*// byang sems bla ma yi dam dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// thugs rje'i dngos grub char 'bebs gyur// phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lha// sgra grag sngags kyi rang sgra ldir// dran rtog ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ

zhes bsnyen pa ci nus su bzlas la/ ma yengs pa'i ngang nas khyer so gsum dang ma bral bar bya'o// de nas rang nyid lhag pa'i lha yi nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pa de yi mdun du mkha' 'gro rnams gsal btab cing bskyed pa ni 'di skad do// hrīḥ rang nyid lhar gsal mdun gyi sa gzhi'i dbus// 'ja' zer 'od kyi mdangs 'tsher kun tu dkrigs// shel gyi gur la g.yu yi chon phur btab// mu men 'phrul gyi pa tra ris bskor zhing*// ka na ka yi rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi// yid 'ong bsti gnas 'chi med zhing bdag po'i// skyed tshal las kyang ches cher rmad byung ba'i// legs pa'i dpal gyi yon tan phul du gyur// de dbus chu 'dzin dra ba spel ba'i nang*// nyi zer pad+ma rgyas pa'i gdan steng du// ti yig yongs gyur myur mgyogs shugs ldan pa'i// cang shes dung mdog g.yu rngog dar stan can// gser sga g.yu yi srab mthur shel yob dang*// rin chen gser dngul la sogs du ma yi// rgyan ldan steng du hrīḥyig yongs gyur las// dpal gyi lha mo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso// ma gcig dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma ni// nya rgyas chu shel 'od kyi sku mdog la// dbu skra lcang lo thor tshugs dung thod can// zhi ma khro 'dzum zhal gcig spyan gsum ldan// phyag gnyis g.yas kyis thod pa'i cang te'u 'khrol// g.yon gyis thod pa mtshan ldan nor bu yis// bkang pa bsnams zhing dar dkar dri med kyi// na bza' bkra shis re khā bkra ba can// lhab lhub dar sna lnga yi cod pan dang*// gser dang in+d+ra nī la mu tig g.yu// mthon ka margad pha lam ke ke ru// pad+ma rā ga la sogs rin chen dang*// mchog gi nor bu bsam 'phel 'dod 'byung gis// dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul chu ska rags dang*// do shal se mo do dang phyag zhabs kyi// gdu bu dngul gyi g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan// gsang gsum yon tan rab rdzogs sku can gyur// sprul pa'i tshul ston ye shes ḍā ki ma// 'brong chen la zhon gtsug na nor bu ni// dkar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen dang*// thod pa nor bus bkang 'dzin dar ber ljang*// gsol zhing rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs// cang shes mtshal bu la zhon dam tshig gi

/mkha' 'gro yid bzhin dmar skya zhal gcig pa// phyag gnyis ne'u le thod par rin chen gtams// dar dmar ber gsol mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras// mkha' lding la chibs dbang gi ma mo ni// khams gsum gzi 'phrog dmar mo zhal gcig pa// phyag gnyis zangs gri lcags kyu dar ber gsol// thod pa skam rlon rin chen rgyan gyis spud// bong bu gwa dmar la zhon sha za mo// karma ḍā ki mthing nag rngam zhal gcig /phyag gnyis ral gri bhan+dha tsit+ta rol// glang ko zhing lpags dur khrod dpa' chas brjid// kun kyang mthu stobs gzi mdangs gsal bar bskyed// hrīḥ sman btsun ḍā ki chos srung yongs kyi gtso// bkra shis tshe ring dpal ster lha mo ni// gangs seng dkar mo g.yu ral la chibs pa// puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i mdog can zhal gcig pa// phyag gnyis gser gyi rdo rje tshe yi bum// dpal be'u g.yung drung dga' ba 'khyil pas mtshan// lha rdzas kai la sha yi kha dog can// na bza' lhab lhub dbang po'i gzhu 'dra ba'i// rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes par spras// zhi 'dzum mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal du 'bar// mkha' 'gro chen mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// mi g.yo blo bzang cod pan mgrin bzang dang*// gtad dkar 'gro bzang la sogs sku mdog ni// sngo ser dmar ljang phyag na me long dang*// ba dan lha yi zhal zas ne'u le// nor bu rin chen sgrom dang dur wa'i rtsa// lto 'gro'i zhags bsnams rgyan ldan dar ber gsol// chibs su rkyang bu rgya stag sman sha dang*// g.yu 'brug sogs la rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs// tshe ring mched kyi lha lnga gsal bar gyur// gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chen mo so so yi// sprul pa yang sprul bran dang pho nya'i tshogs// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu ldan yul lha rnams// ma nges rnam 'gyur sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur// bstan la gus dang rnal 'byor grogs mdzad cing*// phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i mthu ldan gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum sa bon dang*// rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho dang*// khyad par bskyed pa lta bu'i ḍā ki'i tshogs// dam tshig gnyen po'i tha tshig dran bzhin du// rang bzhin gnas nas 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur//

bdug spos 'thul zhing rol mo ldir la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snang srid chos sku'i zhing khams nas// bka' brgyud bla mas byin phob cig /dag pa longs sku'i zhing khams nas// yi dam lha tshogs byin phob cig /gang 'dul sprul pa'i zhing khams nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dang*// bka' dang dam tshig pho brang nas// chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// byin chen phob la dngos grub stsol// snang ba dbang sdud phyi nang gi /bar chad rkyen bzlog phrin las bzhi// myur du 'grub phyir gshegs su gsol// 'og min bde chen dag pa'i zhing*// ma tshogs sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas// dus gsum rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum// gtso mo rdo rje phag zhal can// singha mu kha'i klong yangs nas// sgyu 'phrul gar gyi rol rtsed kyi// dpal 'bar sprul pa'i lha mo che// dharma tā ra 'khor bcas dang*// bkra shis tshe ring lha mo lnga// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi mdangs ldan// rnal 'byor dam ldan sgrub pa pos// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// dgyes pa'i snyan 'gyur glu sgra ldir// brtse ba'i spyan zung bung ba g.yo// ma thogs skad cig ngang nyid la// nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' spyod dang*// yul chen so gnyis dur khrod brgyad// gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog nas// mkha' 'gro chen mo 'khor dang bcas// bu yug 'tshubs bzhin gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī mān gu ru de wa dharma tā ra ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra i dzi dha ri pañca ḍā ki badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza/ zhes spyan drangs zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis drangs te mdun bskyed dam tshig par sib sib mtsho la char babs pa bzhin dmigs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med gyur// ho/ 'dir bshams dar dang rin chen gyi// khri mchog dri med pad+ma dkar// 'dab stong ge sar rgyas pa'i steng*// nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'tsher bar// 'khor bcas bde bar bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

a ti pū ho/ de ltar gdan 'bul dang phyag 'tshal nas/ hrīḥ dbyings kyi yum chen 'khor dang bcas// sngon tshe dkyil 'khor gtso mchog dpal// rig 'dzin pad+ma sam bha wa'i// bka' dang dam tshig rjes dgongs la// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// mnyam med 'jig rten gsum mgon pos// rdo rje'i bka' las ma 'da' bar// deng 'dir brgyud 'dzin sgrub pa po// bstan dang bstan 'dzin gang zag la// srung skyob mi 'bral rtag par skyongs// ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya/ ma ti kra ma ti sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ zhes sngon gyi tha tshig g.yar dam rjes su dran nas rnal 'byor pa'i dam la gnas par mos la/ mchod pa ni/ bh+rūm̐ las rat+na'i snod yangs par// gtor rdzas sman dang rak+ta dang*// mchod yon dag byed ka ma la// dri ldan mdangs gsal byugs pa'i ngad// ro bcud snyan pa'i sil khrol rnams// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// dharma tā ra 'khor bcas dang// bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga 'khor// sprul par bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// zag med bde ba chen por rol// gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ ne wi de/ shab+da/ pañca a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de nas bstod pa ni/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi glu yis drangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ chos sku dri med mkha' ltar khyab// longs sku gsal mdangs lhun gyis grub// sprul sku nyin byed dbang po ltar// gang 'dul der snang pad tshal gyi// dge legs 'dab stong grol ba'i gnyen// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas bstod// dz+nyā na ḍā ki yongs kyi gtso// dbyings phyug ma mo 'khor bcas dang*// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro mched zla lnga// sprul dang yang sprul dkar phyogs skyong*// mthu ldan rnams la bstod par bgyi// grub pa brgyad dang phrin las bzhi// mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa// gang bcol thogs med nyid du sgrubs//

de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed gtso mo'i thugs ka ru// zla steng hrīḥyig dkar po gsal// mkha' 'gro bzhi yi thugs kar yang*// ha ri ni sas mtshan par gyur// hrīḥmathar sngags phreng mu tig mdog /g.yon du 'khor las 'od 'phros pas// mchog gsum rtsa gsum mchod pas mnyes// sems can kun gyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs// thugs dam rgyud bskul 'od zer gyis// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*// rtsa gsum rig 'dzin dpa' bo dang*// ḍā ki dam can mthu nus stobs// sku dang 'bru gsum phyag mtshan dang*// 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas// rang dang mdun bskyed la thim gyur// srog sngags ni/ oṃ dz+nyā ṇa ḍā ki nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ gha mu a tsi ta shwa ra dharma tā ra ma ma tsakra swā hā/ yar 'dus/ sarba 'dus/ ma ma/ dz+nyā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra de ma ḍā ki ni sarba ma ma 'dus 'dus hūm̐ phaṭa/ de ltar sngags phreng gsal bar bsgom// spro bsdu dang pos rgyal rnams mchod// gnyis pas byin rlabs dngos grub bsdu// snying po ci nus bgrangs pa'i mthar// spro bsdu gsum pa 'di ltar dmigs// mda' dar g.yab cing spos bsregs la// slar yang bdag mdun thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros las bzhi mkha' 'gro dang*// bkra shis tshe ring 'khor bcas kyi// thugs rgyud bskul te 'od zer dang*// rang rang phyag mtshan spros pa las// 'byung lnga'i bcud dang srid gsum gyi// lha klu gnod sbyin mi ma yin// mi bdag 'byor pas dregs rnams kyi// tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags// dbang thang zas nor longs spyod kun// khab len rdo yis lcags bsdus ltar// 'od zer phyag mtshan rnams la bsdus// khams gsum gling bzhi khor yug bcas// dbang sdud mnga' dbang bsgyur bar gyur// kun gyi snying po'i yang bcud rnams// bdag dang mdun bskyed gtso mo la// 'bul bzhes dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i char// dngos grub mtsho la char babs gyur// oṃ gha mu a tsi ta/

shwa ra dharma tā ra/ ma ma tsakra swā hā/ yar 'dus/ sarba 'dus/ rā dza rā dza 'dus/ ma ma dz+nyā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra/ de ma ḍā ki ni ye/ ma ma ā yu puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ lo ka wa shang ku ru sarba rat+na sid+dhi pha la dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes 'dod gsol spel tshig can gyi bsnyen pa la 'bad par bya'o// 'khor rnams 'od zer spro bsdu la 'dren pa tsam las sngags zur du med pa ni/ gtso mo nyid la gnad du bsnun pas 'khor rnams shugs kyis 'grub par 'gyur ba ni gnad thun mong ma yin pa'o// 'di nyid 'grub pa'i rtags ni/ bud med chas bzang gis zas nor ster ba dang*/ nyi ma 'char ba dang*/ ri la phyin pa/ me tog 'thu ba/ 'ja' shar/ 'bru yi rigs smin pa dang skye ba rmis na dngos grub nye ba'i ltas dang*/ sems 'tshubs/ ting 'dzin mi gsal/ byings rmugs/ rmi lam du bud med khro ba/ gos ngan can dang mdze mo'i gzugs dang mtshan ma ston pa sogs byung na/ nyams grib kyi rtags dang mchod pa dman pa yin pas/ mdun bskyed kyi spyi bor rdor sems bskyed la yig brgya bzla/ 'di nyid kyi skong ba dang bshags pa nan tan du 'bad par rigs so// de nas mchod pa'i rim pa la// byin rlabs bsangs sbyangs spel ba rnams// sngon du song zhing mchod pa'i rdzas// yid 'ong kun tu bzang po yi// smon lam ji bzhin bskyed la phul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku kun tu bzang po dang*// longs sku khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// sprul sku rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung*// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas nas// sangs rgyas byang sems sras dang bcas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug te lo dang*// nā ro mar mi sgam po pa// dus mkhyen phag gru ras chen zhabs// karma pa sogs kaṃ tshang gi /snying po don gyi brgyud rnams dang*// a mes tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang*// sras bzhi kyu ra'i gdung brgyud kyi// skyes mchog 'jig rten gsum mgon po// 'bri gung rin chen sgrub brgyud kyi// grub brnyes bla ma rim byon dang*// bde dgyes gsang 'dus mā yā dang*// rnal 'byor ma sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// gnas gsum skyong ba'i dpa' bo dang*// ḍā ki chos srung dpal mgon po// yab gcig legs ldan bing ber nag

/gur dang zhal bzhi rang byung rgyal// rnam sras dzaṃ lha dpal mo sogs// pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can tshogs// spyan drangs mdun mkhar gsal bar gyur// hrīḥ lha sman mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog ma// a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma dang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag mkha' 'gro bzhi// tshe ring mched lnga la sogs pa// dbang phyug ma mo nyi shu brgyad// brtan ma bcu gnyis skyong ma dang*// za gsod 'phrog byed gtum mo dang*// srog gi spu gri sha za mo// sprul dang yang 'khor bsam 'das rnams// phyogs mtshams bka' sdod phyag gnyan ma// mu ran skyong bar khas blangs shing*// sangs rgyas bstan la 'dud pa dang*// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i dam tshig can// khyed rnams mchod pa'i bye brag ni// khams gsum snod bshams nang bcud kyi// snang srid 'dod yon ri ltar spungs// mtsho ltar bskyil zhing nyi ltar gsal// kun bzang smon lam ji bzhin du// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi dngos// sbyangs spel bsgrub pa'i mchod pa'i sprin// mkha' dbyings gang bar 'phro bar gyur// de nas dang po phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ ho/ dpal mgon gyur bla ma yi dam dang*// chos skyong dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtso// ma chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor bcas la// chu yan lag brgyad ldan yid 'ong 'dir// dgyes pa dang brtse ba'i ngang du rol// oṃ shrī mān gu ru de wa dharma pā la ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ 'di rigs 'gre'o// dpal mgon gyur= chos skyong dang = ma chos kyi= zhabs bsil byed dal 'babs zegs ma sbreng*// dgyes pa dang = oṃ shrī mān sogs nas/ badz+ra pad+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dpal mgon= chos skyong = ma chos kyi= mdangs ldan gyi pad+ma'i tshal chen 'di// dgyes pa= oṃ shrī mān sogs/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dpal mgon= chos skyong = ma chos kyi= bsung ngad ldan spos sprin drwa ba 'thul// dgyes pa=

oṃ shrī mān sogs/ badz+ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dpal mgon= chos skyong = ma chos = snang gsal byed nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'tsher// dgyes pa= oṃ shrī mān sogs/ badz+ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dpal mgon= chos skyong = ma chos kyi= dri gur gum ge sar byugs pa'i chab// dgyes pa = oṃ shrī mān sogs/ badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dpal mgon= chos skyong = ma chos kyi= bcud lha yi zhal zas ro ba rgya ldan// dgyes pa= oṃ shrī mān sogs/ badz+ra nai wid+ya pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dpal mgon gyur= chos skyong = ma chos= sgra snyan pa'i rig byed sna tshogs ldir// dgyes pa= oṃ shrī mān sogs/ badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ rol mo'i rigs 'bud brdung dkrol bar bya'o// 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ rmad byung mtshar sdug lang tsho bkra// snyan dbyangs ka la piṅka'i 'gyur// gdung sel ha ri tsan+dan dri// rtsi bcud dwangs ma'i zas mchog bshams// dbang gzhu ltar mdzes lha'i reg bya// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa yang*// 'bul gyi dgyes brtses rol par mdzod// oṃ shrī mān sogs sngags gong dang 'dra/ badz+ra rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de nas bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni/ rin chen mu tig za 'og brgyan pa yi// nor bu'i tog can gdugs bzang gser nya 'khyugs// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bum pa chu skyes kyi// pad+ma 'dab stong skye ba lnga pa'i dung*// dpal be'u mi nub rgyal mtshan lhab lhub g.yo// gser gyi 'khor lo bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul// oṃ shrī mān sogs/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga lam he tu pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad 'bul ba ni/ sgrib med rnyog pa dang bral me long rab tu gsal// nyon mongs dug gsum 'ching ba sel byed gi haṃ dang*// rtsi dang bcud kyi snying po rnam par dag gtsang zho// tshe grangs med par 'phel 'gyur sngo 'jam dur wa'i rtswa// yid la 'dod 'jo lhun gyis grub ster bil ba'i 'bras// chos kyi sgra dbyangs srid na ldir ba'i g.yas 'khyil dung*// brtan g.yo ma lus dbang du spel byed li khri ste// bdud bzhi'i dpung gzhom yungs kar bkra shis rdzas mchog rnams// 'bul gyi thugs rjes brtse dgongs dgyes par rol par mdzod// oṃ shrī mān

sogs/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga lam dra bya pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni/ gling bzhir dbang bsgyur 'khor lo// dgos 'byung yid bzhin nor bu// bde ster btsun mo rin chen// zab yangs 'phrul ldan mi bdag /stobs bcu ldan pa glang po// rdzu 'phrul rtsal ldan rta mchog /phas rgol tshar gcod dmag dpon// rgyal srid rin chen bdun yang*// 'bul gyi dgyes brtser rol cig /oṃ shrī mān sogs/ sab+ta rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes phyi mchod kyi rim pa rnams grub nas/ nang mchod sman gyi bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ oṃ/ thod pa mtshan ldan yangs pa'i nang*// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i// sman mchog ye shes bdud rtsi dngos// 'bul gyi dgyes brtser dgongs shing rol// oṃ shrī mān sogs/ pañca a mri ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ āḥ lcang lor bcas pa'i ka pā lar// rgyu drug bsgral ba'i dmar cher bskyil// chags med rak+ta'i rba rlabs sbrengs// 'bul gyi dgyes brtser dgongs shing rol// oṃ shrī mān sogs dang*/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ īn+d+ra nī la'i pad snod nang*// 'bru bcud rin chen sman sbyar ba'i// dkar dmar rgyan mdzes bdud rtsis bran// gtor chen 'bul gyi dgyes brtser rol// oṃ shrī mān sogs dang*// ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ thabs shes gnyis med zung 'jug sbyor// bde chen dga' bzhi ye shes dngos// bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa ste// zag med bde ba'i ngang du rol// oṃ shrī mān sogs dang*/ ma hā su kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de nas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa chen po ni/ ho/ chos kun gdod nas stong pa la// blos byas gnyis 'dzin chos rnams kyang*// ye shes rang snang rtsal las grub// ma 'gags rang gsal ngang du 'bul// oṃ shrī mān sogs nas/

dharma dhartu shun+yā ta dz+nyā na gar+bha aḥhūm̐/ de ltar mchod pa phul ba yis// rtsa gsum sku gsung thugs mnyes nas// bdag gzhan bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shing*// ma tshogs mchod pas dgyes gyur nas// rnam bzhi'i phrin las dngos grub kyi// char gyi dpal 'byor rgyas par bsam// de nas lha tshogs ma lus par// snyan dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho yis// phyag 'tshal bstod par 'jug pa ni/ oṃ skye 'gags gnas bral rang bzhin klong yangs nas// sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos kyi srung ma'i tshogs// thugs rje'i snang byed 'od kyis zhing kun khyab// rmad byung byin rlabs sprin phung thibs se thib// mchog thun dngos grub char rgyun si li li// gus pas thal sbyar ku muta zum byas nas// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo// don dam chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang nyid las// ma 'gags rang rtsal sgyu 'phrul gar ston pa'i// du ma ro gcig snang stong bde chen sku// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdod nas don gyi ye shes mngon gyur kyang// snying rjes 'gro la rjes chags byang sems blos// thabs mkhas gang 'dul sprul pa'i skur bzhengs ma// bcom ldan dharma tā rar phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs rje gting mtha' med pa'i rgya mtsho las// srid zhi'i gdung sel rig 'dzin yid bzhin dbang*// dgos 'dod byang chub nor gyi mchog rnams kyi// skyed pa'i yum gyur ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// lta bas mi ngoms gzugs sku mtshan bzang bkra// tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan zab zhi spros bral thugs// tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// a phyi chos kyi sgrol mar phyag= nyon mongs las kyi nad gdon zhi mdzad cing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas byed ma// snang srid dbang sdud gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral// mched zla mkha' 'gro sde bzhir phyag=

dpung gi shugs 'chang za byed dpa' mo'i gtso// bstan dang bstan 'dzin phrin las spel ba'i grogs// rigs kyi yum chen lnga la phyag= dam tshig rjes gcod bka' yi bya ra ba// dbang mo nyer brgyad brtan ma skyong rnams dang*// za gsod 'phrog byed pho nya shan pa'i tshogs// mthu dang rtsal ldan rnams la bstod par bgyi// de ltar bstod nas/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// dgyes mchod khyad par rmad byung ba// gsang pa dam rdzas tshogs 'khor lo// 'bul ba'i rim pa bstan par bya// dang po tshogs sbyangs spel ni/ hrīḥ rang nyid bla mar gsal ba yi// thugs las 'od zer skar ltar 'phros// zhal zas 'dod yon tshogs la thim/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsreg gtor bkrus// slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'phros nas// zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ tshogs dang po 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ bla med bla ma rgyal dang sras// yi dam chos skyong ḍā ki'i tshogs// dam rdzas tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi// mchod bzhes dbang dang dngos grub stsol// gha na tsakra sarba pū dza kha kha khā hī/ zhes tshogs phud phul nas/ bar pa bskang bshags ni/ tshogs dang bskang gtor mchod pa rnams gso bran legs par byas te/ sman gtor rak+ta sbreng zhing spos bsreg /rol mo ldir la 'di skad do// hrīḥ phyi snod snang srid rab 'byams zhing*// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin spro ba'i// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// lha tshogs dgyes pa skong byed gyur// oṃ sarba dharma su tsa pañca rat+na ka ya go te bi bha ba kaḥswa bhā wa shud+dha3ṃ/ hrīḥ ye nas ma bcos rang byung spros bral dbyings// chos sku kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskang// rang mdangs ma 'gags rtsal las longs spyod sku// lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang chen thugs= gang 'dul sprul bsgyur gar gyi rol rtsed can// o rgyan pad+mā ka ra'i=

phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs dus gsum 'gro la gzigs// sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi= rab 'byams ye shes dkyil 'khor klong yangs nas// yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi= gnas gsum rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nas// grub chen dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes las dang 'jig rten chos srung ma// dregs byed dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// bh+yo/ bcom ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i rnam par 'phrul// rig 'dzin gsang ba'i dgyes sde dbyings phyug ma// bstan skyong mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal 'bar ma// ma gcig dharma tā ra'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes ḍā ki gtsug na nor bu dang*// dam tshig mkha' 'gro chen mo yid bzhin nor// dbang gi lha mo khams gsum gzi 'phrog phyed// gtum mo la sogs sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// lha sman rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// rdo rje khros ma rdo rje bzhad pa mo// rdo rje dpal mo rdo rje gar mkhan ma// bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// gzhan yang dbang phyug rnal 'byor nyer brgyad dang*// brtan ma bcu gnyis za gsod 'phrog byed kyi// sha za mkha' 'gro sprul dang yang sprul tshogs// dam ldan bka' nyan yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/ thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// yon chab bdug spos snang gsal dri// zhal zal rol mo 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas mchog brgyad// rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dang*// ri rab lhun po gling bzhi dang*// gling phran rol mtsho khor yug bcas// phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// ye shes lnga ldan a mṛ ta// 'khor ba yongs bsgral rak+ta dang*// 'bru sman rin chen gtor mar sbyar// nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// khyad par bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ zag med bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i// tshogs gtor sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang// gzhan yang nor dbyig longs spyod mdzod// mda' dar rgyan ldan rten gtor dang*// za le shel sgong cang shes 'brong*// dkor nor sna tshogs phyi yi rten// khrung khrung dkar mo dung mdog can// yid 'ong rgyal mtshan nang gi rten// mdzes pa'i sku 'bag sba lcag dang*// snying po dzab bzlas bstod pa'i dbyangs// rdo rje'i glu bskul snyan pa'i sgra// dngul dkar dri med ā dar+sha// sku gsung thugs kyi rten rdzas dang*// sman spos sna tshogs sil snyan dang*// rol mo'i bye brag yon tan dang*// phrin las rten gyi thugs dam bskang*// mi 'bral phrin las kun bsgrub phyir// rten dang rgyun gyi gtor ma dang*// phud gtsang gser skyems shel snod bshams// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig

/rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// yum gyur ma yi thugs dam bskang*// dharma tā ra'i= mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo'i= bstan srung chen mo'i= sman btsun chen mo'i= bka' srung lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum// thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// chos srid dpal grags longs spyod rgyas// snang srid dbang bsgyur bran du khol// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// byad phur rbod gtong chags che zlog /phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod//

ces lha tshogs thugs dam bskang zhing*/ bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum ye shes kyi// spyan dang ldan rnams dgongs su gsol// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnal 'byor bdag la gsan du gsol// sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba dang*// yan lag dam tshig 'gal zhing nyams// dam rdzas ma tshang ting 'dzin g.yel// mchod gtor lo zlar 'gyang ba dang*// snod min rnams la gsang sgrog dang*// lus dang ngag yid 'chol bar spyod// mi dge'i las gyur thar pa'i gegs// kun kyang byang dag tshangs par stsol// oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma yā sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ de nas tshogs tha ma bsgral bstab ni/ na mo/ rtsa ba gsum dang mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor bcas bka' yi bden pa'i mthus// bstan dang rnal 'byor 'tshe byed pa'i// dgra bgegs byad ma 'dir khug cig /a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ lan gsum/ bh+yo/ sha za ḍā ki'i dus la babs// za gsod 'phrog byed gtum mo'i tshogs// mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa yis// gnod byed phung khams rdul du rlogs// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su stims// sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad/ kyis bsgral nas zhal bstab ni/ dgra bgegs sha khrag don snying rnams// ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur byas nas// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang*// ma tshogs bye ba 'bum sde yi// zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus gsum don snying rnam lnga bzhes su gsol khā hi/ zhes phul nas/ skabs 'dir tshogs la longs spyod cing lhag ma rnams bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas rkang gling dang bshug pa'i sgras lhag sdud rnams bkug pa ni/ bh+yo/ dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi// shar lho nub byang dbang phyug ma// rnal 'byor dkar ser dmar ljang mdog /mgo brnyan phyag mtshan sna tshogs ston// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// nad gdon zhi zhing tshe bsod rgyas// khams gsum dbang sdud dgra bgegs sgrol// las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du// myur du sgrubs shig sa ma ya// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa si swā hā/

zhes 'bul nas bshal chu shin tu lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ bh+yo/ mkha' dbyings īn+d+ra nī la'i mdangs 'tsher ba'i// mthing gsal 'od 'bar sra brtan g.yu yi brag /gter sgrom shel gyi pho brang nang shed nas// che zhes srid pa'i rgyal mo mthu chen ma// rig 'dzin rgyud kyi srung ma thugs dam can// rnal 'byor dgra lha chen mo 'khor dang bcas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir dbyings nas bskul// sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal phyir dbyings= las bzhi'i phrin las bcol phyir= byad ma rbod gtong bzlog phyir= 'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la babs// dkar phyogs sde dpung kun gyi gtso mo ste// bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga 'khor bcas kyang*// bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i srung ma g.yar dam can// ye shes las dang 'jig rten ḍā ki'i tshogs// sangs rgyas bstan srung rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel// rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog phyir dbyings= bstan dgra sgos dgra bsgral phyir dbyings nas= 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las g.yel med bsgrub par mdzod// ces bskul te dmar gtor gnyis dbul bar bya'o// de nas chad tho ni/ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe chos dbyings dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du// bcom ldan kun tu bzang mo'i spyan snga ru// bla med don dam byang chub sems bskyed ltar// tshad med snying rje chen pos brtser dgongs nas// mchog thun dngos grub stsol bar ma chad dam// snod bcud byin rlabs 'bebs par ma chad dam// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// de 'og gnas mchog gter sgrom shel brag tu// o rgyan chen po pad+ma thod phreng gi /spyan sngar las kyi ma mo'i skur bstan nas// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor skyong bar g.yar dam bcas// dri med 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan// phyogs mthar khyab cing spel ba'i phrin las grogs// zhal bzhes tha tshig gnyan la ma 'da' bar// mchod gtor bzhes la bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// de 'og ljongs 'dir gzugs sku'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// rigs sras gdung rgyud spel zhing 'gro don skyongs// mnyam med 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' bsgos bzhin// bka' brgyud bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam// ma 'ongs rjes 'jug skyob par ma chad dam// sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// phyi nang bar chad rkyen zlogs 'gal rkyen sol// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// da lta sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor gyis// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phyes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bsnyen cing brten nas mchod bstod bskul ba'i tshe// ji ltar dam tshig brtse gdung 'bral med par// rnal 'byor srung zhing skyob par ma chad dam// 'khor gyi phrin las lha mo bzhi dang ni// tshe ring mched lnga ma tshogs bye ba 'bum// gtso mo bka' bzhin dam tshig rjes dran nas// snying po'i bstan pa spel dang skyong ba dang*// las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol bar ma chad dam// dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dang*// ltas ngan cho 'phrul bzlog par ma chad dam// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod//

ces rol chen dang bcas gtor ma phul nas/ gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu dang*/ yul lha sogs la dkar gsum ldan pa'i gtor 'bul ni/ a kā ros bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ sngon tshe pad+ma sam bhā was// dbang bskur bka' dang dam tshig can// tshangs dbang brgya byin rgyal chen bzhi// phyogs skyong bcu dang lha chen brgyad// klu brgyad gza' brgyad gnod sbyin brgyad// rgyu skar lha mo nyer brgyad dang*// lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag dang*// gnyug mar gnas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon lnga// bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// rnal 'byor skyong zhing las bzhi dang*// thun mong dngos grub 'dod dgu'i gter// myur du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// gzhan yang bcol ba'i phrin las kun// thogs med bde blag bsgrub tu gsol// zhes dkar gtor phul/ de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bh+yo/ rgya gar bal bod yul ljongs su// gnas pa'i skyong ma yal gam can// rdo rje kun grags ya ma skyong*// kun bzang ma dang bgegs kyi gtso// rdo rje dpal ldan khyung btsun ma// drag mo rgyal dang mkha' lding ma// kong btsun rdo rje sman gyi yum// g.yar mo bsil dang zu le ma// bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo ste// sngon tshe mchims phu'i dben gnas su// slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang*// glang ri dpal gyi seṅge yis// dbang bskur dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong bar// khas blangs tha tshig dran par gyis// bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la// bsam pa sgrubs la tshe bsod spel// bar chad rkyen zlogs nad yams kyi// dal kha bsgyur la mtshon rtse thul// bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// ma ma hring hring ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes gtor ma dang bshal chu phul/ de nas rjes kyi rim pa la/ gtang rag gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mchod rdzas rnams gso bran legs par byas te/

bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod rnams su// mchod rdzas yid 'ong phun sum tshogs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas// zag med bde chen skyed byed gyur// ho/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang*// ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas la// gtsang byed mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// yid 'ong me tog bdug pa'i spos// rmad byung snang gsal dri chab gtams// ngo mtshar zhal zas rol mo ldir// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste// gsang gsum dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir*// sman dang gtor ma rak+ta'i tshogs// snang srid yongs bskang mchod pa'i sprin// 'bul gyi thugs brtser dgyes dgongs la// bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī man gu ru de wa dharma pā la ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ/ paṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tits+tsha ye swā hā/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she āḥhūm̐/ ma hā pañca ba liṃ ta rak+ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes phul/ de nas gsol ka phul ba ni/ gtor ma dkar gsum brgyan pa'am/ phud phor pad snod can du bdud rtsi dang gser skyems bshams la skabs su sbreng zhing*/ oṃ/ shel dkar dri med gsal la mdangs 'tsher ba'i// pad snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang rol du// 'bru bcud stong sbyar lha yi bdud rtsi dwangs// rin chen gser skyems yid 'ong rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī/ lan gsum brjod nas/ ho/ sku gsum ston pa sangs rgyas byang sems// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam chos skyong*// gnas gsum dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs dpon// dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma yum dang*// phrin las bzhi yi ngo bor snang ba'i// ye shes dam tshig dbang dang las kyi// mkha' 'gro ma tshogs sprul pa yang sprul// dpung gi rtsal ldan dpal gyi lha mo// bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug mched lnga// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde// 'khor dang bcas rnams gsol lo mchod do// u rgyan chen po'i bka' yi gnyer gtad// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi bstan srung*// tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dam ldan grogs byed// dam med log lta bdud kyis bslus pa'i// chos min tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las// mthu rtsal myur mgyogs ldan pa'i srung ma// 'khor dang bcas rnams gsol lo mchod do// khyed rnams gsol dang mchod pa la brten// bcom ldan shāka thub pad ma kā ra'i// ring lugs snying po don gyi yang bcud// nges gsang bla med bstan pa rin chen// phyogs mthar khyab dang spel ba'i grogs mdzod// ye nas rgyal bas lung zin bstan 'dzin// sprul pa'i skyes mchog 'gro don rgyas shing*// 'dus pa'i sde tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel// chos bzhin spyod pa'i skye dgu kun kyang*// srung dang skyob dang sba bar mdzod cig

/ma gcig brten cing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor// tshe mthar phyin cing dge tshogs ji snyed// yid bzhin lhun grub dpal dang 'byor rgyas// snyan grags dbang thang bsod nams ye shes// mi nub rgyal mtshan bzhin du bsgreng ba'i// dam tshig bka' las ma 'da' tshul bzhin// sgrubs shig spel cig bcol ba'i phrin las// da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzod cig / ces rin chen bdud rtsi'i skyems nam mkha'i dbyings su mchod nas/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ sgrub brgyud bstan srung phrin las myur mgyogs ma// rdo rje can gyi bka' dang dam tshig can// mchog rnams bskyed pa'i rgyal yum 'phags ma ste// a phyi chos kyi sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod// gtso mo las sprul mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi// gzhan yang sprul pa yang 'khor tshogs rnams bstod// grub pa'i dgyes sde sman btsun dpal gyi yum// tshe ring mched lnga bran g.yog dam can tshogs// dang ba'i yid kyis rab tu bstod par bgyi// zhes mchod dang bstod pas 'khor bcas rab tu dgyes shing tshim par mos la/ phywa g.yang 'gug pa'i 'dod gsol sogs spro na 'dir bya zhing*/ de min mchod phreng lta bu la skabs 'dir dngos grub blang ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rtsa ba gsum gyi sku las dngos grub kyi char dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dngos grub kyi tshul du gtso mo la thim/ de nyid kyi sku yi cha nas mi zad pa'i longs spyod 'dod yon char bzhin babs nas rang nyid dang rten rdzas rnams la thim par bsgoms shing*/ hrīḥ ma gcig mkha' 'gro chen mo yis// dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// 'khor gyi ḍā ki'i thugs ka nas// 'od zer 'phros nas gtso mor thim// sku yi cha nas mi zad pa'i// rin chen nor bu 'dod dgu'i char// lha klu mi yi longs spyod bsdus// bdag dang sgrub rdzas rnams la thim// dpal dang 'byor pa lhun grub gyur// oṃ ḍā ki ni sarba ma ṇi rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/

gsum mam nyer gcig bzla'o// de nas nongs pa bzod gsol ni/ ho/ dbyings phyug sprul pa'i yum chen 'khor bcas dgongs// snang sems gdod nas kun bzang rol pa la// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri mas bslad pa yi// sku yi dam tshig nyams pa bzod par gsol// grag stong ngo bo gsung gi cha shas las// snying po sngags kyi dzab bzlas sgra zur chag /bag med nyes pa'i rdul phran cha bsags pa// gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa bzod par gsol// lha bskyed zab mo'i ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang*// spro bsdu'i dmigs pa 'thib cing don ma rtogs// ma rig log rtog nyon mongs 'phro rgod kyis// thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bzod par gsol// bla ma lha dang rdo rje spun grogs dang*// pha mar brnyas shing sdang sems tshig brlang sogs// snod min nyams pa can la gsang ba bsgrags// mtshams med las bgyis thams cad bzod par gsol// gzhan yang mchod gtor ma tshang phud nyams pa// rgyud dang dus kyi gtor ma lo zlar 'gyang*// tshul bzhin mi ldan le lo'i dbang gyur pa'i// nongs pa ci mchis bshags so dag tshangs stsol// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ chad lhag bskang nas 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hrīḥ bde chen dga' ster rgyal kun yum gyur ma// rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen mo 'khor bcas rnams// bsten cing bsgrub dang mchod bstod bskul ba'i mthus// bstan pa dar rgyas 'gro la phan bde spel// rnal 'byor bsam don lhun gyis grub pa dang*// bla med byang chub chen po mngon gyur nas// u rgyan mkha' spyod bcom ldan rnam snang ma'i// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med ro gcig shog / ces smon lam btab la/ de nas mdun mkhar bskyed pa'i rtsa gsum rnams rang la thim par mos shing*/ ho/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ka dang*// 'bru gsum ngo bor 'od zhu nas// rang nyid lhar gsal gnas gsum la// thim pas sgo gsum sgrib dag nas// sku gsum 'bras bu mngon du gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra dz+nyā ṇa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ lan gsum mam nyer gcig brjod/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams rten gtor ram/ sku brnyan sogs la dbyer med du bstim pa ni/ bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*// ma yis bu bzhin skyong ba ltar// rtag tu brtse bar bzhugs su gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang me tog gi char bsnyil zhing 'di skad do// oṃ/ bkra shis gang zhig chos dbyings nam mkha'i klong*// mtha' bral dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*// chos sku'i bkra shis deng 'dir khyab gyur nas// bkra shis des kyang bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog /bkra shis gang zhig bde chen nyin mor byed// ye shes lnga ldan bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// longs sku'i bkra shis deng 'dir rab tu gsal// bkra shis des kyang bstan 'dzin 'tsho gzhes shog /bkra shis gang zhig rang rtsal zla snang dkar// thabs mkhas gar gyi rnam rol pad+ma 'byung*// sprul sku'i bkra shis deng 'dir kun snang nas// bkra shis des kyang sgrub pa mthar phyin shog /bkra shis gang zhig byin rlabs skar tshogs 'char// nges pa'i don ston bka' brgyud grub thob tshogs// bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir rnam par bkra// bkra shis des kyang dam chos dar bar shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje sprin ltar gtibs// rab 'byams rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha// yi dam bkra shis deng 'dir phyogs bcur g.yo// bkra shis des kyang dge 'dun sde rgyas shog /bkra shis gang zhig phrin las 'brug stong ldir// ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// chos skyong bkra shis deng 'dir srid gsum sgrog /bkra shis des kyang bdud las rnam rgyal shog /bkra shis gang zhig dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char// dharma tā ra ḍā ki bye ba 'bum// mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis deng 'dir char rgyun 'bebs// bkra shis des kyang las bzhi lhun grub shog

/bkra shis gang zhig phyi snod 'byung ba bzhi// nang bcud srid zhi'i dpal gyi yon tan kun// skye dgu'i bkra shis nyin mtshan dpal 'bar ba'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /maṅga laṃ shrī dza ya dza ya su dza ya/

zhes brjod cing*/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// sogs kyis 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs shing*/ bsngo ba smon lam yang dkyus ltar bya'o// rjes ni/ bdag nyid bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor pa// rim bzhin 'od zhu hrīḥl thim// de yang dmigs med blo 'das kyi// khyab bdal chen po'i klong du bzhag / ces dus gsum spros pa dang bral ba rang gsal brjod med ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas/ ci snang ci shar gyi chos nyid thams cad ye shes lnga yi rol par spyod par bya'o/// / ༈ de ltar rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 'di nyid kyi che ba'i yon tan zur tsam brjod na/ phyi ltar na mdo sngags kyi tshad mar gyur ba'i ring lugs yongs dang*/ khyad par sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan pa rin po che'i bka' srung gtso mor bsngags shing*/ nang ltar na chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong du kun tu bzang mo'i rol pa ste rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro/ gsang ba ltar na o rgyan rang byung gan+dho lar ḍā ki'i tshogs dpon chen mo ste/ ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi sprul bsgyur du mas 'gro ba rnams legs pa'i lam la bkod cing*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ster ba dang*/ tshe dpal spel cing 'dod dgu dbang du bsgyur ba dang*/ bstan dgra thal bar brlag pa sogs dam tshig can la snying nye zhing*/ bkra shis la byin chags pa/ phrin las rno la thugs rje myur ba/ mthar thug o rgyan mkha' spyod kyi zhing du 'dren par nus pa'i mthu dang byin rlabs ches khyad par 'phags pa dang*/ mnyam med 'bri gung ba chen po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchog la sogs pa dang*// gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen dharmā shwa ra sogs bstan pa'i bdag po rnams kyang*/ kyu ra'i gdung zhes chos dang srid kyi dbang 'byor pa/ sna nam bza' a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i rigs sras kyi gdung brgyud dri med las 'byon par grags pa'i/

deng gi bar grub brnyes gong ma rnams kyi bka' dam la gnas pa'i rigs chos rgyud kyi srung ma thun mong ma yin pa mngon sum tshad mar grub cing*/ zhi sgrub phal cher la gtso 'khor bzhengs stabs can las zhon pa sogs med kyang*/ 'dir ni phrin las myur mgyogs rtsal ldan gyi rten 'brel ched du bsngags shing*/ 'khor du tshe ring mched lnga bskyed pa'ang dpa' dang dpung gi tshul gyi dgos pa khyad par can du/ sngon gyi rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi rdo rje'i bka' gsang las byung ba dang*/ 'di nyid bsnyen cing brten pa'i rnal 'byor pas byams snying rje sems bskyed dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsgrub na ji bzhin nges shes skye ba'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar can 'char ba yin no// de ltar bstan pa'i bka' srung chen mo'i mchod phreng 'di yang dbon sprul karma 'chi med kyis bskul bar brten/ si tu sprul sku pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos dpal spungs chos 'khor gyi yang dben du spel ba bstan 'gro phan bde'i dge legs kyis khyab par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam// ༈ mchod phreng bkra shis char 'bebs kyi gud sbas nor sgrub bzhugs so// na mo pad+mā ka ra dhe wa ḍā ki ni ye/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs bka' yi gnang ba stsol/ 'dir bstan pa'i bka' srung chen mo rig 'dzin rgyud kyi srung ma chos skyong phrin las myur mgyogs a phyi chen mo'i sgo nas tshe g.yang dngos grub 'gugs pa'i rim pa la/ mchod gtor bshams bkod sogs gzhung gis 'thus shing*/ thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du rin po che sna lnga dang 'bru sna sman sna sogs kyis bskang ba dang*/ mda' rgod sgro ma la/ dngul gyi me long*/ rin chen sna lnga/ dar sna stag ras kyis brgyan pa dang*/ gzhan yang g.yang rdzas gang 'byor stegs kyi khar bshams la/ sngon du rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyi ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas kyi bskyed bzlas mchod phreng tshogs dang skong bshags sogs dang*/

bskul chad tho brtan skyong grub nas/ gtang rag mchod 'bul dang*/ gsol ka dang bstod pa tshar nas dngos grub len chog dang stabs gcig 'dir 'jug par bya ste/ ma yengs ngang nas mda' dar g.yab cing bdug spos bsregs la 'di skad do// oṃ/ ma gcig yon tan kun 'byung gnas// dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon bzang bzhin// yid la 'dod 'jo'i dpal ster ma// khyod kyi thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos// ma khyod mchod cing bsten pa'i mthus// dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs// sku yi dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol// thugs rje'i thugs dam ma g.yel cig /brtse ba chen pos rjes dgongs nas// dpal 'bar gtso mo yum gyur ma'i// thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i// phywa g.yang nor bdag dbang phyug ma// rgyas byed lha mo gser mdog can// zhi 'dzum zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas// ne'u le g.yon pas ka pā la// yid bzhin nor bus phyur bur bkang*// za 'og ber ser lhab lhub gsol// 'khyugs ldem gar stabs lings se ling*// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan ldan gsal// mdun bskyed rtsa gsum sku las kyang*// 'od 'phros tshe lha rigs lnga dang*// sgrol ma nor rgyun lha mo'i tshogs// rnam sras rmugs 'dzin dzam lha'i rigs// sku dang phyag mtshan dngos grub kyi// 'dod dgu'i longs spyod sprin ltar gtibs// rgyas byed dpal mor gnyis med thim// 'khor tshogs mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi// thugs las 'od zer sna tshogs dang*// phywa g.yang dngos grub kun bsdus nas// sprul pa'i lha mor thim par gyur// de las dngos grub nam mkha'i mdzod// ji bzhin rgya chen mtha' klas pa// lha klu mi yi phywa g.yang gi /tshe bsod dpal grags longs spyod kyi// dwangs bcud yid bzhin nor bu'i char// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// nyi ma bzhin du kyi li li// zla ba bzhin du sga ra ra// skar tshogs bzhin du spungs se spungs// bar mtshams med par gang bar gyur//

ces dmigs nas/ oṃ dz+nya na ḍā ki ni ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gha mu a tsi ta shwa ra dharma dz+nya na sa ma ya ta ra di ma ḍā ki ni ye/ sarba ma ṇi rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ sngar bzhin mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya'o// rtsa ba gsum gyi sku las dngos grub kyi char dang*/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams dang*/ sprul pa'i lha mo'i sku yi cha nas phywa g.yang zas nor thams cad sib sib babs nas gnas lus longs spyod dkor nor sogs la thim zhing chil gyis gang bar dmigs te sngags bzla'o// slar rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i tshogs spro bar dmigs nas/ oṃ dharma tā ra rat+na ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pad+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pū dza ho yis mchod nas bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ rat+na nor gyi dpal g.yang can// rgyas byed lha mo dbang phyug ma// rin chen mkha' 'gro gter bdag yum// yid bzhin lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rtsa gsum gyi// thugs rje bskul ba'i mthu stobs las// 'chi med tshe mthar phyin pa dang*// 'dzad med longs spyod thob par gyur// ces brjod nas// lha mo de nyid zhi 'dzum dgyes pa'i mdangs dang mtshar sdug 'od dang ldan pa'i ngang nas sku rten nam/ gzhan yang*/ rten rdzas khyad par can sogs la yang yang thim par bsam/ slar grangs sogs gsog na/ mchod pa gsar du brje ba'am/ kha gso ba dang*/ gser skyems phud mchod kyang bshams la/ gong gi gtang rag mchod pa de dang*/ gsol ka bcas dang*/ bstod pa grub mtshams g.yang 'gugs dmigs pa sngags bzla ba sogs kyis thun tshod bzung zhing*// mthar thun rjes ma ni gzhung gi dngos grub len pa de bzhag nas/ de min nongs pa bzod gsol sogs la dkyus ltar 'jug par bya'o// de ltar ye shes mkha' 'gro'i las tshogs kyi// tshe g.yang 'gugs pa'i thabs gnad spel ba la// nongs pa mchis na ḍā kis bzod par mdzod// dge bas bstan 'gror bkra shis khyab gyur cig
